name: OV5640 5MP DVP/MIPI camera module
description: A 5 MP sensor with on-chip JPEG, a VCM autofocus driver and both DVP and 2-lane MIPI outputs. It's the high-end choice for ESP32-S3, STM32 DCMI and RP2040 cameras, and it does 90 fps at VGA.

variants.note: Adafruit breakout, 72° autofocus lens, 2×9 0.1" header, onboard 24 MHz clock

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

variants.note: IADIY 24-pin FPC module, 120° lens (72°/120° AF options), 21 or 78 mm FPC (body = camera head)

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: Max frame rates: 2592×1944 15 fps, 1080p 30 fps, 720p 60 fps, VGA 90 fps, QVGA 120 fps.
Autofocus only works on modules with a VCM lens. The AF firmware is loaded over I²C at start-up.
Runs warm, so give it heat-sinking (the Adafruit breakout has a thermal pad). OmniVision recommends MIPI for high-resolution YUV.
Full 5 MP frames on an ESP32-S3 need PSRAM even with JPEG.
